posts.trend: India’s top 8 office markets may need 260 m sq-ft of additional space: Study
posts.context: Five years after companies bragged about permanent remote flexibility on social media, those promises have been quietly replaced by new office leases.
posts.angle: The permanent remote work revolution lasted exactly until the next real estate lease was signed.

landing_options.line: 2021 wali "remote forever" post abhi bhi pinned hai.
